notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Fixes-[/b]
-You can now shift+tab out without the mouse glitching
-All of the controls that are displayed while playing the game now switch depending on if you are using controller or keyboard

notes.title: Fixing Performace And Playablity
notes.content:
[b]Fixes-[/b]
- Now on low settings the game is playable and can now be completed
- Fixed some performance issues by bringing down the texture sizes
- Fixed some other minor problems

Thank you for the feedback!
